about: HOME (rules 343, 347, 354): YOUR settlement's lots and what can stand on them, and what puts it there. ONE LOT TEMPLATE for every settlement type (rule 354(k)): twelve lots, three rows of four, each row a step back and up, a height limit per row; a piece may stand on any lot of its row. A modder's file: a later boss adds one row to pieces (its prize, its row) and the pipeline renders it from the fixed cameras with no hand step (tools/bohemia_home_settlement_pipeline_11_3_26.py; pictures in records/target/home_settlement/). Every word is draft:true; every number is a shape TUNING owns and is READ from the file that already rules it (records/target/bb/boss_act_one.json for the prizes, engine/bohemia_lotbuild.js CATALOG for the builds), never typed new here.

states.bare: the lot as it is: nothing stands there (the camera's plate shows it)
states.built: it stands, not yet doing its job
states.working: it does its job: the fire lit, the water running, the crop up, the cells charging

pieces.name: YOUR KITCHEN

put_there_by.when: his kill: his pot comes home with you

pieces.what_it_is: a cinder-block rocket hearth with his pot on its grate, the flue up through a tin lean-to, a prep table, a woodpile
pieces.working_when: the fire is lit (the cook verb used)

pieces.name: YOUR MAIN

put_there_by.when: his kill: his wrench opens the city line under your gate

pieces.what_it_is: the curb-stop box over the city main, a riser out of a concrete pad, a gate valve with a red wheel, the spigot on a post, a wash trough

pieces.name: YOUR PURIFIER

put_there_by.when: her kill: her filter becomes the pre-filter on a slow sand bed

pieces.what_it_is: the raw drum up on blocks, her filter housing as the pre-filter, a timber box of fine sand over gravel, the outlet low into a clean drum
pieces.working_when: water stands on the sand (it takes it from your main)

pieces.name: GARDEN BED
pieces.what_it_is: three timber raised beds of soil, bean poles at the back

pieces.name: WATER TANK
pieces.what_it_is: a corrugated tank on a block stand with a sight tube and a tap, a tin roof and its downpipe
pieces.realism: STORAGE, not a source: Las Vegas rain (106 mm a year) gives a shed roof about 1.5 litres a day against one person's 15 (records/BOHEMIA_HOME_YOUR_OWN_SETTLEMENT_11_3_26.md s5.1); it holds what your main or purifier gives

pieces.name: SOLAR PANEL
pieces.what_it_is: three panels on a ground rack at 36 degrees to the south, a battery cabinet, a lamp on a pole
pieces.working_when: it is wired and the cells charge
